Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix: all callbacks unresponsive due to Dash duplicate output errors

Dash 2.18''s callback grouping merges chained callback outputs,
causing "Duplicate callback outputs" errors on the frontend that
silently blocked ALL callback dispatch.

- Add allow_duplicate=True to all outputs involved in callback chains
- Merge update_selected_path_display into open_file_browser and
  handle_fb_item_click to eliminate grouping conflicts
- Add missing callbacks: apply_desi_defaults, apply_tims_defaults,
  apply_output_defaults
- Add switch_to_history_tab for sidebar load_session button
- Add prevent_initial_call=True to update_result_folders

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
